method: R1 blind suread (subagent read text only, no md/rules)

facts.fact: Natalie 领 Hattie 穿过厨房，说一小时后要去接儿子。
facts.anchor: I have to pick up my son in an hour.

facts.fact: Natalie 说两人并非真要离婚，只是分居并在努力修复关系。
facts.anchor: We were separated, but we were working on it.

facts.fact: Natalie 清空了 Eeling 的公寓，只留下笔记本和她还没看的邮件。
facts.anchor: I cleaned out his apartment and threw almost everything away except his laptop and some mail I haven’t gone through yet.

facts.fact: Natalie 问 Eeling 死前是否说过让他可能做这种事的话。
facts.anchor: Did he say anything that made you think he might do something like this?

facts.fact: Natalie 说 Eeling 喝酒更多了，通话时能从声音里听出来。
facts.anchor: I know he was drinking more.

facts.fact: Hattie 请 Natalie 搜索一封来自 Donald Ramsby 的邮件（结果零命中）。
facts.anchor: It might’ve been an email from a Donald Ramsby.

facts.fact: Hattie 在邮件堆底部发现寄件人写着 D. Ramsby 的马尼拉信封，并请求打开。
Hattie 撕开信封倒出六张光泽照片，挪到倒数第二张时停住。
facts.anchor: Hattie tears the envelope open and slides half a dozen glossy photos out onto the tabletop.
